root_cause: When trajectory [group=7, pair=14] hit env.reset timeout (3000s), trajectory_collect_engine._original_input fell back to self.env.task. In SWEEnv, dataset entries are stored on self.entry rather than self.task (which defaulted to {}), so the fallback original_input lacked the 'prompts' key. During batch merge, original_inputs lacked 'prompts', causing agentic_grpo_learner.py:775 to raise KeyError: 'prompts'.
remediation: In examples/deepswe/swe_env.py, initialize self.task = dict(self.entry) and ensure self.task['prompts'] = [self.entry.get('problem_statement', '')] so that pre-observation reset timeout trajectories preserve valid task metadata with 'prompts'.
